architecture.stage1_adapter: Frozen task-agnostic spatial observation uncertainty U; it does not predict driving relevance or actions.
stage2_l_trainable: U-independent spatial task-relevance queries and R-map head
compact task-risk bridge K = U * sigmoid(R)

geometry_eligibility.retained_support: Each retained keyframe has either a visible route corridor or visible support from an actor whose predicted occupancy conflicts with the unmodified ORION plan.

pilot_gate.selection_rule: Within the explicitly supplied reviewed formal-wave shards, exclude only hash-bound technical geometry failures, then take the first eligible accepted events in frozen formal-route-plan order separately for each split quota; never rank by collision, TTC, UQ, or Stage2 outcome.

unlock_requires: Route196 structured-semantic report passes every preregistered gate
the frozen formal pilot bank satisfies 8 events, 3 towns, 4 scenario families and a preserved 6/2 split
all selected multi-frame QA geometry is reviewed and hash-bound
a separate immutable launch amendment explicitly activates one pilot run

stage2_p_locked_until: held-out on-path versus off-path risk ordering passes
structured stance and generated QA agree
zero-UQ and irrelevant-UQ false-conservatism checks pass
claim_boundary: This schedule governs event-bank preparation and future Stage2-L decisions. It does not authorize training and provides no trajectory, closed-loop, or safety evidence.
